item.title: Matte Black Bottle on Marble

turns.text: Make a product photo of a matte black water bottle on marble, with soft light.

item.tests: Produces a finished product image from text while honoring the stated material, setting and lighting.
must_haves: A water bottle is the main subject and is fully visible.
The bottle has a matte black finish rather than a glossy or metallic finish.
The bottle stands on a visibly veined marble surface.
Lighting is soft, with gentle shadows rather than harsh glare.

style.prompt: Premium photorealistic studio product photograph of a single matte black reusable water bottle standing upright on a white marble countertop with subtle gray veining. Minimalist unbranded bottle with a matching black cap, elegant clean silhouette and realistic fine matte texture. Soft diffused daylight from the left, gentle natural shadow, restrained highlights defining the black surface. Neutral warm off-white background, uncluttered composition, bottle fully visible and centered with generous negative space. High-end commercial product photography, crisp detail, natural proportions, no text, no logos, no extra objects.
